title: QSARena: a portable, leakage-controlled AutoML workspace for molecular property prediction
description:
QSARena predicts molecular properties from SMILES through a single reproducible workflow: RDKit standardization, ten fingerprint and descriptor families including a MapLight-style composite, train-only filtering and ElasticNetCV feature selection, and a model library spanning conventional machine learning, gradient boosting, deep tabular networks, message-passing graph neural networks (Chemprop v2), descriptor-graph hybrids (MapLight + GNN), 3D pretrained models (Uni-Mol V1 and V2), and combinatorial-fusion and stacking ensembles.

It is delivered as both a code-free Jupyter/Colab notebook and a resume-safe command-line benchmark runner that share one workflow core.

This archive includes the complete benchmark artifacts for 44 datasets across five suites (Therapeutics Data Commons, MoleculeNet, Polaris ADME, PODUAM, ChemML), including per-molecule predictions that are excluded from the Git repository for size reasons, together with the analysis notebook and the scripts that regenerate every figure, table and quoted number in the accompanying paper.
